answer.held_back_by: Probably being too honest and low-politics. The party's estimate was only Senior Minister of State, and I still made Minister, so I wasn't held back much. My STAND kept dipping when I did the right thing, so maybe I wasn't flashy enough.
answer.ending_fair_why: Retired as a Minister with clean integrity, and the card explained why. The reveal that I had a hidden ceiling the whole time was a good twist. I only wish I had seen those estimates earlier.
answer.chase_next: I'd try the dirty or political route to see if I could go higher than Minister, maybe even PM. I played honest all the way, so I want to see how bad it gets if I play it the other way.
answer.play_again_why: It was a long run and the middle years blurred together. I'd come back another day for a quick dishonest run, but not right now.
answer.title_fit_why: The game was about whether you got confirmed and promoted, with the potential estimates and appraisals, not about the pay. The salary was just a number on screen. 'Confirmed & Substantive' sounds boring but fits.
